items.reason: The evidence points toward BOM:build-plate/build-base but does not settle the link. For it: the title D-024/drawing/title is "ByggeBase", which reads as Build base. D-024/drawing/notes says "Aluminium.", and D-024/drawing/material says "3.3315 (EN-AW 5005)", an aluminium grade; both are consistent with the BOM:build-plate/build-base material ["Aluminium"]. Against it: the drawing section is "Z-axis" and the BOM row section is "Build-plate". The task says not to assume differing section names are already approved as equivalent. The drawing has no datasheet link to the BOM (the row's datasheet is []). The drawing also notes "Hul til varmeelement" (hole for heating element). That could relate to the separate Aluminium row BOM:build-plate/heating-element-plate. The row BOM:build-plate/build-base mentions only a thermocouple hole, so it does not confirm the link. The proposed unknown/null is consistent with this ambiguity. Fixing the link needs a human to decide whether Z-axis and Build-plate are equivalent sections, or new evidence such as a datasheet reference. A new proposal from the existing evidence cannot do it.
